title: Open-Meteo historical archive, Cortina d'Ampezzo and Forcella Lavaredo, 25-27 June 2015-2026
claims: For the grid point 46.5369, 12.1357 (Cortina d'Ampezzo, model elevation 1,198 m) over 25-27 June of 2015-2026, 36 days: daily maximum 16.3-31.0 C with a median of 21.4 C; daily minimum 5.8-16.8 C with a median of 11.35 C; 22 of 36 days reached 1 mm of precipitation, 14 of 36 reached 5 mm, and the maximum daily total was 34.1 mm.

For the grid point 46.5358, 12.2092 downscaled to 2,300 m near Forcella Lavaredo, over the same 36 days: daily maximum 9.6-23.6 C with a median of 14.4 C; daily minimum -0.8-10.3 C with a median of 4.65 C; 23 of 36 days reached 1 mm, 12 of 36 reached 5 mm, and the maximum daily total was 34.1 mm.
These are gridded model values, not on-course measurements; the 2,300 m point is a downscaling and the 2027 race-week weather was unknown at the check date.
